critic.verdict: A clear, purposeful pull-back for loss. It opens tight on the man from behind, head in hands, then eases back to reveal the lamp-lit desk, rotary phone, tender files and the crane-filled window around him, leaving him smaller and isolated in the office. The subject stays coherent through the move with no visible tearing, doubled edges, halo or painted-over ghost, layers that belong together stay together, and no layer clips the frame awkwardly; both the tight first frame and the full final frame are strong still pictures to open and dwell on. The dust is subtle and the flat halftone silkscreen print character is preserved throughout.
